name: @ark/am32-cli
description: ark32 -- headless configurator for AM32 ESCs behind a flight controller.
//exports: Deliberately absent. This is a bin-only package: `files` ships dist/ark32.mjs and nothing else, so an `exports` map pointing at ./src/*.ts would resolve to files the tarball does not contain. Nothing imports am32-cli by package name -- its own modules use relative paths and no other workspace depends on it.
//dependencies: serialport is the only runtime dependency, and it is the only one that can be:
am32-core, am32-node and am32-sim are workspace packages that are never
published, and esbuild inlines their TypeScript source into dist/ark32.mjs.
